rules.description: Applicant must be a first-time buyer
rules.reason_if_failed: You can only use your Lifetime ISA for your first home purchase
The property must cost £450,000 or less to use your Lifetime ISA

rules.description: Must have held LISA for at least 12 months since first payment
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have held your Lifetime ISA for at least 12 months since your first payment

rules.description: Purchase must be made with a mortgage
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be buying the property with a mortgage to use your Lifetime ISA

rules.description: Cannot use private mortgage from relatives
rules.reason_if_failed: You cannot use your Lifetime ISA if you're getting a private mortgage from a relative, spouse, or civil partner

rules.description: Must use a conveyancer or solicitor
rules.reason_if_failed: You must use a conveyancer or solicitor to act for you in the purchase. The ISA provider will pay funds directly to them.

rules.description: Must be a UK resident or armed forces/crown servant
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be a UK resident, member of armed forces, crown servant, or their spouse/civil partner to use a Lifetime ISA

rules.description: Must be at least 18 years old to have opened LISA
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have been at least 18 when you opened your Lifetime ISA

explanation_template: Lifetime ISA first home purchase eligibility: {outcome}

edge_cases.description: Both buyers have Lifetime ISAs and want to use both bonuses
edge_cases.action: Both can use their LISAs if both are first-time buyers and meet all conditions. Process each application separately with same conveyancer details.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has both Help to Buy ISA and Lifetime ISA
edge_cases.action: Inform applicant they can only use the government bonus from one ISA for the purchase. Confirm which bonus they want to claim before proceeding.

edge_cases.description: Attempting to use LISA before 12-month holding period
edge_cases.action: Reject application. Inform applicant they must wait until 12 months after first payment. Alternative: withdraw with 25% unauthorised withdrawal charge.
Reject application. Cannot use LISA for this purchase. Funds remain in account for later life or can be withdrawn with 25% charge for other purposes.

edge_cases.description: Private mortgage from family member detected
edge_cases.action: Reject application. Cannot use LISA with private mortgage from relatives. Applicant must use standard mortgage or withdraw with 25% charge.
